title: Christmas reading guide
intro: Pick a story for home or class. Use the age bands and time estimates as a starting point.
timeNote: Times are approximate and leave room to pause over the pictures or discuss clues.

choices.why: A quiet Christmas Eve story about two chicks trying to stay awake.
A Christmas morning mystery with a parcel and a clue about who gets there last.

choices.time: 25–35 minutes, or one chapter at a time
choices.why: An older-reader mystery about a bell ringing from the wrong shore.

questions: What did a character notice that changed what they did next?
Which detail in a picture helped you understand something the words left out?

activity.title: Draw the next moment
activity.instruction: Choose a character. Draw what they might do after the story ends. Add one sentence about your picture, or tell it to someone.
